excerpt.zh: 从方舟上，我们的岩质蜂群成千上万地降临，吞噬着这个世界的地壳与地幔，直到一切荡然无存。
excerpt.en: From the Arkship, our lithoid swarms descend in their thousands, feasting on the crust and mantle of this world until nothing remains.

sections.zh: 方舟舰必须在180天内返回[Target.GetName]的轨道，否则侵蚀行动将被放弃。
sections.en: An Arkship must return to orbit of [Target.GetName] within 180 days or the consumption will be abandoned.
